messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: Error while deploying shiny App- could not find function melt
parts:
Is this an error you see on shinyapps.io, or in deploying on a shiny server?
If it is the former, the problem is likely to be that you are missing a library() call that includes the package that has the melt function.
If it is the latter, your shiny server may not have the package installed oni t.
